label: Total population, 2020 Census count
definition: Total resident population counted in the 2020 Decennial Census (redistricting file table P1). A count with no sampling margin of error; ACS pop_total is a period estimate and can differ.
source_dataset: 2020 Decennial Census, PL 94-171 Redistricting Data
moe_rule: No MOE (complete count; differential-privacy noise is not published as a margin).
display_rule: Show as 'Census count' with vintage 2020; do not compare to ACS estimates without noting the difference. Counts for school districts cover the whole district, which can extend outside the county.

label: Students enrolled (school corporation)
definition: Total enrollment of the public school corporation as reported to the Indiana Department of Education: pre-kindergarten through grade 12 plus 'Grade 12+/Adult'.
universe: Students enrolled in the corporation's schools (whole corporation, including any part outside the county)
source_dataset: IDOE Corporation Enrollment by Grade Level (corporation-enrollment-grade-2006-26.xlsx, linked from https://www.in.gov/doe/it/data-center-and-reports/)
table_variable: One sheet per school year, named for the year the school year ends (sheet '2026' = 2025-26; the data page lists the file as 'Updated - SY 2025-2026'); column TOTAL ENROLLMENT; row = IDOE corporation id (4805 New Prairie United, 7150 John Glenn, 7175 Penn-Harris-Madison, 7200 School City of Mishawaka, 7205 South Bend Community, 7215 Union-North United).
display_rule: Label as 'school year YYYY-YY'. Includes pre-K; it is not the average daily membership (ADM) used for state funding or in spending per student.

label: Spending per student (school corporation)
definition: The corporation's total expenditures for a calendar year, net of interfund loans, transfers and purchases of investments, divided by its average daily membership (ADM), as computed by the Department of Local Government Finance from Indiana Department of Education data.
source_dataset: DLGF Report on Expenditures Per Capita (April 30, 2026), School Expenditures Per Capita table
table_variable: Columns '2024 Expenditures Per Student' and '2025 Expenditures Per Student'; the rank columns give the state rank among 290 reporting corporations (1 = highest).
display_rule: Label with the calendar year, not a school year. Total spending, not classroom spending: a year with large one-time payments can stand out. Show beside the state median.

label: Spending per student: median Indiana school corporation
definition: The middle value of school_spending_per_student among the school corporations in the DLGF report (not weighted by students).
universe: Indiana school corporations in the DLGF report (290 reporting in 2024 and 2025)
source_dataset: DLGF Report on Expenditures Per Capita (April 30, 2026), School Expenditures Per Capita table
display_rule: Use only as the comparison line for school_spending_per_student, same calendar year.
